title: Mandatory Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery & Artefacts
description: Governs mandatory purity certification of gold jewellery sold by registered jewellers across notified Indian districts.
keywords: gold hallmarking; huid; 6 digit code; bis logo; 22k916; assay centre; jeweller registration
testing_requirements: Fire assay test IS 1418 or XRF testing conducted at BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centre (AHC)

title: Silver Jewellery and Artefact Hallmarking
description: Specifies voluntary hallmarking and purity declarations for silver articles sold in India.
keywords: silver hallmark; 925 silver; sterling silver; silver utensil; silver fineness
testing_requirements: Volumetric or potentiometric titration testing at BIS-recognized hallmarking centres

title: Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) Verification System
description: HUID is a unique 6-digit alphanumeric code laser-engraved onto every hallmarked piece enabling consumer verification on BIS CARE app.
keywords: huid; verify hallmark; bis care app; 6 digit alphanumeric; traceability; gold authenticity
testing_requirements: Central BIS database synchronization verifying jeweller registration date of hallmarking and karat fineness
source_document: BIS Hallmarking Guidelines on HUID Implementation
